debug.changelog:
refactor: update Sentry initialization for JNI compatibility

- Added `@JvmStatic` to `FlavorInitializer.initialize` to allow invocation from native AntiTamper code via JNI.
- Removed the `suspend` modifier and internal `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` block, shifting threading responsibility to the caller.
- Updated documentation to specify the required JNI method signature `(Landroid/content/Context;)V`.

release.changelog:
refactor: update Sentry initialization for JNI compatibility

- Added `@JvmStatic` to `FlavorInitializer.initialize` to allow invocation from native AntiTamper code via JNI.
- Removed the `suspend` modifier and internal `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` block, shifting threading responsibility to the caller.
- Updated documentation to specify the required JNI method signature `(Landroid/content/Context;)V`.

Update launcher icon visuals

Refines the app launcher icon by updating foreground and background gradients to a new blue-purple-red color scheme. Adjusts the foreground shadow, reduces body stroke width, and adds a subtle inner highlight rim for improved depth.
